title: CLI: feed priorBible + closedArcSummaries into arc-rollup bible extraction (06b.1-B)
description:
Wire `rollupCampaignArcIfReady` in `packages/cli/src/play.ts` to populate the new optional inputs added in 06b.1-A.

Parent: loreweaver-06b.1. Depends on 06b.1-A (the new input fields must exist).

Scope:
- Before calling `extractBibleWithRetry`, read the existing campaign bible via `getCampaignBible(db, { campaignId })` and project it into a `CampaignBibleInput` (just the `.text` of each entry per list — `CampaignBibleRecord` uses rich `CampaignBibleEntry` objects, `extractCampaignBible` accepts the plain string-array shape).
- Read closed-arc summaries via `listClosedArcSummaries(db, { campaignId })` (already exists in core; verify it is reachable from CLI — if not currently re-exported, add the export rather than reaching into `/internal` from production code).
- Pass both into `extractBibleWithRetry`; widen its parameter type from `{ campaignId; recaps }` to include the new optional fields.
- Skip empty inputs (don't pass an empty-entry `priorBible` — the extractor should still elide the section when nothing is known yet).
- Add a deterministic test in `packages/cli/test/play.test.ts` that seeds a campaign with a prior bible row + a closed arc summary, triggers the arc-rollover threshold, and asserts that the fake model captured a `messages[0].content` containing both the `## previously known bible` block and the `## closed arc summaries` block.
design:
- Place the lookups inside `rollupCampaignArcIfReady` just after the recap fetch, before the bible call. Both lookups are cheap reads against the live SQLite DB; no need for caching.
- Project `CampaignBibleRecord` -> `CampaignBibleInput` with a small inline helper or a `.map(e => e.text)` per list.
- Widen `extractBibleWithRetry` to forward all of `ExtractCampaignBibleInput` so future fields don't require touching this shim again.
acceptance_criteria:
- Arc rollup in the CLI passes the prior bible (when non-empty) and closed arc summaries (when any closed arcs exist) into `extractCampaignBible`.
- The first-ever arc rollup (no prior bible, no closed arcs) is byte-identical to today's behavior.
- New CLI test verifies the wiring with a fake model + seeded DB rows.
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test` pass.
notes: PR #64 opened against main. Adds 1 new test (recording fake model that captures bible-call inputs across 2*N rollovers). Full suite: 457 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. Awaiting review.
